scientific_scope: published 7nm Sinangil signed Q4K4 positive_negative_split + separately published 7nm Yokoyama FP16 V SRAM + assumed digital online softmax/PV
model: Llama-3.1-8B GQA, B1, P2048, suffix128, O128, 32 heads/8 KV/128 d, one resident layer
verification: Independent local Python reimplementation executes exact K/V macro area, cold-start and stage FIFO scheduling arithmetic.
Online softmax and prefix/suffix fusion regression passed as part of the full 156-discovered-test GitHub source CI, one optional test skipped.
GPU source model FP16 Matmul.roofline_model counts IO elements but divides by bytes/s, a factor-2 memory-term undercount; source corrected separately without overwriting raw evidence.
The larger prefix context endpoint is numerically meaningful only after matching ADC digitized-score response; preserving FP16 V avoids new V quantization.
limitations: Optimized fused Hydragen/FlashAttention GPU full-prefix execution remains unmeasured and unmodeled.
A100 FP16 source model used as legacy simulation; no A100 physical device, no H100 data substitution.
16TB/s V read and 64TMAC/s digital PV with ≤0.5mm2 support are speculative rate sensitivities, not established 7nm digital area.
Rate model reuses full V SRAM per microbatch; GQA multicast within each batch group.
Only a single pinned layer can fit at selected geometry; prefix context output for 31 other layers is unchanged GPU work.
Potential performance benefits are isolated prefix-context service, not full-decoder TPOT or energy.

qualification.supported: source-anchored conditional simulations; not CUDA-measured or fabricated integrated CIM
